full_fill_rule: cumulative qualifying executed size must be at least initial queue ahead plus shadow order size
maker_price_rule: best bid observed at episode start for each YES leg
promotion_rule: no promotion to execution edge from this test alone
purpose: prospective maker fill feasibility only; not PnL validation
qualifying_trade_rule: only taker SELL executions on the same YES token at the exact shadow bid consume queue ahead
queue_rule: join behind full displayed quantity at that exact best bid
rejection_rule: zero fills is negative evidence but not automatic rejection unless a separately preregistered materiality gate exists
trade_source: Polymarket Data API v2 trades with taker_only true semantics
unknown_data_rule: fail closed and do not credit a fill
